race.comment: SMART ENERGY (1) is the standout with the best winning profile, having won two of six and finishing just 2.5 lengths behind as favourite in a CG CL3 at Ascot last seen. While the ten-month layoff is a concern and his 1230m record isn't strong, the 3kg claim helps and his overall form is solid. TRAILER TRUCK (6) lands here third-up, has a favourable distance profile and his recent form suggesting a return to this trip may enhance his performance after two midfield runs. KAMAKAZI SHOOTER (8) boasts good local form, recently trialled at Albany, and had a tough sixth on heavy ground here before the break. He's more likely to place than win, but his distance and wet-track performance keep him in contention. JELLYBEAN JONES (3) has strong claims if fit, previously beating Brave Apache by two lengths in a BM58+ here, and his Lark Hill trial sets a solid base. TORA BORA (10) won't be far away on resumption.
